EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for completing the Red Cross Leaders Save Lives blood drive interest form!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for expressing interest in becoming an American Red Cross Leaders Save Lives blood drive partner. A Red Cross representative in your area will contact you soon regarding next steps. At this time, you may experience a delay in response time because of the resounding response we have received to our recent ask. We appreciate your patience!
In the meantime, we invite you to visit RedCross.org to learn about even more ways you can get involved. We look forward to our potential partnership!
Your American Red Cross
